candidate_selection: explicit frozen candidate name; no default model and no threshold changes

preprocessing.RGB_native: same integer labelpixel for every native9 position, channel RGB*25+dy*5+dx, integer5x5patches, no interpolation
preprocessing.SAM: same selected box-only generic MobileSAM full-resolution logits; exact and actual native5x5 max before nearest native9 sampling; /8clip4
preprocessing.target_box: unchanged q8 minmax clipped to original image; source YCB used annotation-derived jittered box, preserving source distribution caveat
preprocessing.box_grid: continuous native9XY relative to identical SAMbox plusconstant log2(side/box width,height)
preprocessing.context: same input-only weighted valid-cell mean from8 frozen P3 ROIs

outputs.joint_probability: six valid exact/near state pair probabilities
outputs.mechanism: jointMAP pair only ifmaxjoint>=.5 elseUNKNOWN; fixed heuristic, not calibrated real-pallet correctness
outputs.logical_support: pVisible.5 thenpFull.5 decision diagnostic, can callE withpE<.5; not user-facing confidentocclusion
outputs.nearby_support_gap: posterior outside-exact/visible-or-hidden-support-near; not proof of coordinate error
outputs.raw_SAM: exact and real5x5 scores separate, cache reconstruction marked clipped
outputs.self_hidden_geometry_proxy: separate unchanged saved-cuboid geometry flag; no alteration to learned probabilities
outputs.invalid: nonfinite/offimage/sentinel query or emptyROI and missing/degeneratebox ->UNKNOWN
